subject: Next Steps: Lumenix Vendor Profile Completion & PO Routing Path
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Clara Ruiz <clara@lumenix.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next Steps: Lumenix vendor profile & PO routing

Hi Clara —

Great to meet you earlier this week. We're excited to get Lumenix set up as an approved supplier so we can get the initial purchase orders flowing. To speed the vendor-master creation, can you confirm the following items (copy/paste or attach documents is fine):

- Legal entity name as it appears on tax docs (W-9 / W-8)
- Tax ID (TIN / EIN) and type of form submitted
- Registered legal address (street, city, state/province, country, postal code)
- Primary billing email for POs/invoices (where PO will be sent)
- Remittance address (if different from billing)
- Preferred remit method (ACH / Wire / Check) and contact for remittance questions
- AP contact name, email, phone (and secondary contact)
- Example invoice (PDF) showing required fields for reconciliation

I've attached our vendor_onboarding_packet.pdf with the fields we populate in Redwood's vendor master. Once we receive the items above we typically validate tax docs and bank details and then create the vendor record in our system. PO generation follows (typical lead time 3–5 business days after record creation).

If you prefer a secure upload, let me know and I'll send a portal invite. HubSpot deal is #87219 for reference.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Jonas Weber
Senior Procurement Partner
Redwood Inference
-- Attachment: vendor_onboarding_packet.pdf (PDF, 1 page)

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 15:30:00 -0700

Clara —

Thanks for the quick response and for sending the W-9 and redacted bank statement. A couple of procurement notes so expectations are clear: 

- Legal entity on the vendor master must match the name on the tax form exactly. "Lumenix, Inc." is good as long as the punctuation matches the W-9.
- Remit email we will use for PO routing and invoice delivery is billing@lumenix.com — we'll add that to the vendor record as the primary invoice destination.
- Default terms are Net 30; if you need a different term please flag it now (we'll include it in the vendor profile and escalate if needed).
- For ACH, please upload the beneficiary name, account number, and routing number via the secure portal we will send — do not email account numbers in the clear.

I'll run the W-9 against our compliance checks and then request vendor-master creation. Expect vendor creation + initial PO ready in ~3 business days after verification. If any missing fields appear we'll loop you back in.

Attaching our procurement checklist to show the fields we validate.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
